The '''Trulalis system''', also known as the '''Issor system''', was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It was the [[Arkanis sector/Legends|Arkanis sector's]] economic engine and home of all legal trade in the sector. It contained three productive worlds. [[Issor]] and [[Cadezia]] were industrialized planets. [[Trulalis]] was home to a widely regarded university that attracted students from surrounding sectors.<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Trulalis system was first mentioned in ''[[The Final Exit]]'', published in [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 4|''Star Wars Adventure Journal'' 4]]. ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' also states Trulalis as being a part of the Trulalis system. However, ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' gave the name of the system as the Issor system.
